description: Synthetic Celia numerical reference; one ice-free 0.6 m soil column with 100 cells. Original physical parameters, initial state, forcing and prescribed-head boundaries preserved. Original iterative solver retained. Matric heads compared with the public 2020 HydroShare benchmark. Only file-manager paths/newlines are adapted. No basin, coupled-chain or general multiphysics validation.
source: Knoben, W. J. M.; Clark, M. P.; Nijssen, B.; Wood, A. W.; Bennett, A. (2023). SUMMA v3.x Test Cases, HydroShare. https://www.hydroshare.org/resource/e4df3065264341a48017f6d2f4ad030c/ Archive SHA256 35a66bd3fadf3e4cd3a1ba4a1fcc328b8d69c06f1264a29068751da25e23d829
expectations: one timestep NetCDF with 120 half-hourly times from 2000-01-01 00:30
one HRU and GRU, HRU ID equal to attributes, 100 soil layers
mLayerMatricHead dimensions exactly (time, midSoil, hru), units m, finite and unmasked
all 120x100 matric heads agree with the public iterative benchmark
tolerance_rationale: Date conversion permits 0.1 ms; forcing permits float32 output roundoff. 1e-7 m absolute plus 1e-6 relative allows platform/compiler roundoff around the independently distributed iterative solution; a local 1 mm perturbation is rejected. See containers/hydrology/NUMERICAL-REFERENCES.md.
